title.zh: 内联仪表盘

steps.zh: 调用 show_dashboard。
steps.en: Call show_dashboard.

expected.zh: 服务表显示在成功工具记录内，随内容调整高度。
expected.en: The successful tool record contains a service table that reports its content height.

title.zh: 模型与页面工具可见性

steps.zh: 查看模型工具列表，再在服务页点刷新。
steps.en: Inspect the model tool list, then refresh in the Services tab.

expected.zh: refresh_data、toggle_health、cancellable_check 只供页面调用。
expected.en: refresh_data, toggle_health and cancellable_check are available only to the App.

title.zh: 页面调用与原始工具结果
title.en: App calls and raw tool results

steps.zh: 服务页选择筛选条件，点击刷新。
steps.en: Choose a filter in Services and click Refresh.

expected.zh: 表格更新，主对话不新增模型回合或工具行。
expected.en: The table updates without adding a model turn or tool row.

title.zh: 成功结果自动打开侧栏
title.en: Open successful results in the side pane

steps.zh: 调用 open_editor。
steps.en: Call open_editor.

expected.zh: 成功结果的 fullscreen 偏好打开侧栏。
expected.en: The successful result opens the side pane using its fullscreen preference.

title.zh: 内联、侧栏与 pip 降级
title.en: Inline, side pane and PiP fallback

steps.zh: 操作页依次请求侧栏、内联与 pip。
steps.en: Request fullscreen, inline and pip in Actions.

expected.zh: 同一页面移动，pip 返回宿主实际支持的模式。
expected.en: The same page moves; PiP reports the actual supported mode.

title.zh: 通过宿主打开外链

steps.zh: 操作页点击外链按钮。
steps.en: Click the external link button in Actions.

expected.zh: 宿主在浏览器打开链接；不会在插件内导航。
expected.en: The host opens the link externally without navigating the App.

title.zh: 有手势与无手势后续消息
title.en: Follow-up with and without a gesture

steps.zh: 操作页先发送，再点 6 秒后发送并移开鼠标等待。
steps.en: Send a follow-up, then schedule the six-second message and stop interacting.

expected.zh: 有手势直接发送；无手势显示可编辑确认，取消不发送。
expected.en: A gesture sends immediately; otherwise an editable confirmation can be cancelled.

title.zh: 带结构化数据的后续消息

steps.zh: 操作页点击带 structuredContent 发送。
steps.en: Send the structuredContent follow-up in Actions.

expected.zh: 用户消息附带 JSON，模型接着回答。
expected.en: The user message includes JSON and starts a normal model turn.

title.zh: 下一轮模型上下文
title.en: Context for the next model turn

steps.zh: 选择服务行，再把所选行加入上下文。
steps.en: Select service rows and add them to model context.

expected.zh: 输入框出现可删除 chip；更新本身不发消息。
expected.en: A removable composer chip appears; updating context sends no message.

title.zh: 图片上下文与格式拒绝

steps.zh: 操作页分别加入 PNG 柱状图和 GIF。
steps.en: Add the PNG chart and then the GIF in Actions.

expected.zh: PNG 成为附件；GIF 明确报不支持，不静默丢弃。
expected.en: PNG becomes an attachment; GIF returns an explicit unsupported-format error.

title.zh: 宿主内存 widgetState

steps.zh: 状态页计数加一；切任务返回，再重启应用比较。
steps.en: Increment State, switch tasks and return, then restart the application.

expected.zh: 同一任务内存快照可恢复；应用重启后不保留。
expected.en: The task snapshot can be restored in memory but does not survive an app restart.

title.zh: 部署表单接受、拒绝与取消
title.en: Deployment form accept, decline and cancel

steps.zh: 调用 deploy(service=billing)，分别确认、拒绝和取消。
steps.en: Call deploy(service=billing), then separately accept, decline and cancel the form.

expected.zh: 仅确认写入模拟部署记录；拒绝/取消不写入。
expected.en: Only confirmed requests change simulated deployment data.

title.zh: 服务监控 surface 路由

steps.zh: 先打开侧栏服务监控，再调用 inspect_service(billing)。
steps.en: Open Service Monitor in the side pane, then inspect billing.

expected.zh: 详情进入已打开的 surface；未打开时可内联展示。
expected.en: Details enter the open surface, or appear inline when it is closed.

title.zh: 失败详情保留上次成功页面
title.en: Failed detail preserves the successful page

steps.zh: 先查看 billing，再调用 inspect_service(nosuch)。
steps.en: Inspect billing first, then inspect nosuch.

expected.zh: 失败不新建卡片、不替换 billing 的成功内容。
expected.en: The error creates no card and does not replace the successful billing view.

title.zh: 资源读取与跨来源拒绝

steps.zh: 资源页读取 JSON、PNG，再读其他插件 URI。
steps.en: Read JSON and PNG, then try another plugin's URI in Resources.

expected.zh: 同源资源可读；越权读取拒绝。
expected.en: Same-source resources load; cross-source access is rejected.

title.zh: 列表与资源模板

steps.zh: 资源页列出资源与模板，读取 service/billing.json。
steps.en: List resources and templates, then read service/billing.json.

expected.zh: 固定资源、模板实例和模板定义完整，未知服务报错。
expected.en: Fixed resources, template instances and the template are listed; unknown services fail.

title.zh: 订阅、通知与取消订阅

steps.zh: 订阅 services.json，翻转健康态；取消订阅后重复。
steps.en: Subscribe to services.json and toggle health; unsubscribe and repeat.

expected.zh: 订阅时 updated 后重新读取；退订后停止该通知。
expected.en: Updates trigger explicit rereads while subscribed and stop after unsubscribe.

title.zh: 动态工具与动态资源

steps.zh: 订阅后注册实验工具两次，下一回合请求容量预测。
steps.en: Subscribe, register the experimental tool twice, then request a capacity forecast.

expected.zh: 列表通知可见，forecast_capacity 可发现，重复注册无重复项。
expected.en: List notifications appear; forecast_capacity is discoverable without duplicate registration.

title.zh: 模拟服务崩溃与订阅重放

steps.zh: 先订阅，再明确调用 simulate_crash；之后刷新并翻转健康态。
steps.en: Subscribe, explicitly call simulate_crash, then refresh and toggle health.

expected.zh: 模拟进程重启；观察调用与订阅恢复，内存模拟数据重置。
expected.en: The demo server restarts; verify calls and subscriptions recover while its in-memory data resets.

title.zh: 模型工具进度与超时声明
title.en: Model tool progress and timeout metadata

steps.zh: 调用 run_health_check，观察主对话工具行。
steps.en: Call run_health_check and watch its main-conversation tool row.

expected.zh: 收到五次 progress；这是模型工具进度，不是 App 调用进度。
expected.en: Five progress updates arrive for the model tool, not App-side tool progress.

title.zh: 服务端诊断日志

steps.zh: 调用健康检查，查看当前 Agent 的 showcase warning。
steps.en: Run a health check and inspect the Agent's showcase warning.

expected.zh: 不健康服务产生 warning；没有凭据或真实业务数据。
expected.en: Unhealthy demo services produce a warning without credentials or real user data.

title.zh: 四种下载与用户取消

steps.zh: 文件页分别下载 CSV、PNG、资源链接和多文件，另做一次取消。
steps.en: Download CSV, PNG, resource link and multiple files, then cancel one save.

expected.zh: 通过宿主保存对话框；取消/失败返回 isError。
expected.en: Host save dialogs are used; cancellation or failure returns isError.

title.zh: 大结果省略与全量重取

steps.zh: 调用 show_audit_log，再点击重取全量。
steps.en: Call show_audit_log, then refetch the full result.

expected.zh: 持久化结构化结果被省略，页面可显式取得完整 1500 条。
expected.en: Persisted structured content is omitted; the App explicitly fetches all 1500 records.

title.zh: 资源元数据与常驻状态条

steps.zh: 调用 show_status_banner，观察边框、高度和折叠行为。
steps.en: Call show_status_banner and inspect border, height and disclosure behavior.

expected.zh: 资源级 meta 优先于工具级；状态条常驻。
expected.en: Resource-level metadata overrides tool metadata and keeps the banner inline.

title.zh: 同一逻辑页面的结果替代
title.en: Result replacement for one logical page

steps.zh: 连续两次调用 show_dashboard，再触发一次失败。
steps.en: Call show_dashboard twice and then trigger a failed tool.

expected.zh: 同 widgetSessionId 最新成功结果承载页面；失败不替代。
expected.en: The latest successful result owns the shared widget; failures do not replace it.

title.zh: 主题、语言、尺寸与宿主能力
title.en: Theme, locale, size and host capabilities

steps.zh: 宿主页观察握手；切应用语言、深浅主题并缩窄窗口。
steps.en: Inspect the handshake in Host, switch app language/theme and narrow the window.

expected.zh: hostContext、文字和样式同步；窄屏可操作。
expected.en: Host context, labels and styles update; controls remain usable at narrow widths.

title.zh: OpenAI 兼容别名与事件

steps.zh: 打开基础宿主页，查看 window.openai 行与事件计数。
steps.en: Open the legacy Host tab and inspect the window.openai row and events.

expected.zh: 基础页面兼容别名可用；实验室自己的 SDK 不另开 alias 连接。
expected.en: Aliases remain available in the legacy page; the SDK lab opens no second alias connection.

title.zh: Ping 与页面日志

steps.zh: 宿主页点击发送 ping、写沙箱日志。
steps.en: Send a ping and sandbox log in Host.

expected.zh: 请求有真实响应，页面日志可观察。
expected.en: The request receives a real response and page logging is observable.

title.zh: 协议通知观测

steps.zh: 日志页触发工具结果、主题切换、订阅更新和关闭。
steps.en: Trigger tool results, theme changes, resource updates and closure while observing Logs.

expected.zh: 记录实际收到的通知；关闭后的 teardown 需外部 fixture 观察。
expected.en: Only received notifications are logged; teardown after closure requires an external fixture.

title.zh: 网络 CSP 允许与拦截

steps.zh: 宿主页访问 api.github.com 与 example.com。
steps.en: Try api.github.com and example.com in Host.

expected.zh: 未声明域被拦；允许域仍可能因离线失败，不把离线当作 CSP 结果。
expected.en: Undeclared hosts are blocked; allowed hosts can still fail offline, which is not CSP proof.

title.zh: region 配置注入

steps.zh: 插件设置修改 region，重连后打开服务表或状态条。
steps.en: Change region in plugin settings, reconnect and open the dashboard or banner.

expected.zh: 显示新的 SHOWCASE_REGION 标签。
expected.en: The new SHOWCASE_REGION label is displayed.

title.zh: 同一活页面保留输入与滚动
title.en: Live page preserves input and scroll

steps.zh: 在保活区输入、加计数和滚动，再切侧栏、内联、其他任务并返回。
steps.en: Type, increment and scroll in Retention, then move to the side pane/inline and switch tasks.

expected.zh: 页面启动标识、输入、计数和滚动保持；没有用快照重建冒充保活。
expected.en: The page ID, input, counter and scroll remain unchanged rather than being reconstructed.

title.zh: 稳定浏览器存储与删除样本
title.en: Stable browser storage and sample deletion

steps.zh: 存储区写入样本；重建页面或重启应用后读取，最后删除样本。
steps.en: Write storage samples, rebuild or restart and read them, then delete the samples.

expected.zh: localStorage 与 IndexedDB 可恢复；删除仅影响本实验室样本。
expected.en: Both stores survive rebuilding; deletion affects only this lab's samples.

title.zh: 长工具调用与取消

steps.zh: 启动十秒只读检查，取消；再次调用等待完成。
steps.en: Start a ten-second read-only check, cancel it, then start another and let it finish.

expected.zh: 取消和成功是不同终态；无写操作和自动重放。
expected.en: Cancellation and success are distinct outcomes with no mutations or automatic replay.

title.zh: 失败、异常和展示偏好

steps.zh: 分别调用 show_failure、show_failure_fullscreen、show_failure_pinned；再设 throwError=true。
steps.en: Call show_failure, show_failure_fullscreen and show_failure_pinned, then repeat with throwError=true.

expected.zh: 失败只留普通记录，不能打开/固定新卡或替换已有成功页。
expected.en: Failures leave ordinary records without opening, pinning or replacing a successful App.

title.zh: App 内文本问答

steps.zh: 在模型区输入问题并点击发送。
steps.en: Enter a question in Sampling and click Send.

expected.zh: 使用当前任务模型，回答留在 App 内，主对话不新增回合。
expected.en: The current task model answers inside the App without a main-conversation turn.

title.zh: App 自己维护多轮历史

steps.zh: 连续问两轮，清空后再问一轮。
steps.en: Ask twice, reset the conversation, then ask again.

expected.zh: 后续请求包含已完成对话；失败/取消不入历史，清空后不再携带。
expected.en: Requests contain completed turns only; errors/cancellations are excluded and reset clears history.

title.zh: 带演示图片的模型请求

steps.zh: 勾选附带演示 PNG 再发送。
steps.en: Include the demo PNG and send a question.

expected.zh: 无敏感信息的固定图片进入请求；图片支持取决于当前模型。
expected.en: The fixed non-sensitive PNG enters the request; image support depends on the current model.

title.zh: 中止模型请求

steps.zh: 发送后在完成前点击取消。
steps.en: Send a question and cancel before completion.

expected.zh: 中止原请求；迟到结果不改对话，下一请求可正常发送。
expected.en: The original request is aborted; late results cannot change history and the next request works.

title.zh: 不支持参数明确拒绝

steps.zh: 依次尝试 temperature、tools 与原生 audio。
steps.en: Try temperature, tools and native audio in turn.

expected.zh: 显示 SDK/宿主拒绝的实际错误，不调用不支持的模型路径。
expected.en: Show the actual SDK/host rejection rather than using an unsupported model path.

title.zh: 能力协商与不可操作任务

steps.zh: 观察宿主能力；在无可操作会话绑定的任务中再打开实验室。
steps.en: Inspect capabilities and reopen the lab without an actionable session binding.

expected.zh: 未声明 sampling 时发送入口禁用并解释；不绕过会话权限。
expected.en: Sampling stays disabled with an explanation when absent; session permissions are preserved.

title.zh: 在途请求随活页移动
title.en: Move a page during an active request

steps.zh: 启动长检查或 sampling，来回切内联/侧栏。
steps.en: Start a long check or sampling request and move inline/side pane.

expected.zh: 同一请求继续，最终结果仍归原页面；不会重发。
expected.en: The same request continues and resolves to the original page without replay.

title.zh: 窗口与工作区隔离

steps.zh: 两个窗口/工作区打开同名实验室，各输入不同内容并发请求。
steps.en: Open labs in two windows/workspaces with distinct input and requests.

expected.zh: 页面与调用互不串线；关闭一个不取消另一个。
expected.en: Pages and requests remain isolated; closing one cannot cancel the other.

title.zh: 回收、快照和手动重试

steps.zh: 基础状态页保存快照；离屏超过五分钟后重开，再手动重试。
steps.en: Save a legacy widget snapshot, leave it offscreen for over five minutes, reopen and retry.

expected.zh: 回收可重建页面并恢复快照；手动重试清快照，浏览器存储仍保留。
expected.en: Recycling may rebuild from the snapshot; manual retry clears it but keeps browser storage.

title.zh: 全局清数据与进程重启

steps.zh: 仅在隔离测试 profile 写样本，使用应用清数据入口并重启后读取。
steps.en: Only in an isolated test profile, write samples, clear browser data via the app and restart.

expected.zh: 新进程 LS/IDB 为空；插件文件/数据库不受浏览器清理影响。
expected.en: The new process sees empty LS/IDB; plugin files/databases are outside browser clearing.

title.zh: 容量、回收与忙碌保护

steps.zh: 运行 retention fixture；生产页面不批量创建 64 个 guest。
steps.en: Run the retention fixture; the production demo does not create 64 guests.

expected.zh: 验证 30 任务、64 页面、五分钟回收及在途保护。
expected.en: Verify 30 tasks, 64 pages, five-minute eviction and busy protection.

title.zh: 旧代次、迟到响应与重复接纳
title.en: Stale generations, late results and duplicates

steps.zh: 运行 chain 和 managed fixture 的受控故障序列。
steps.en: Run controlled fault sequences in the chain and managed fixtures.

expected.zh: 旧凭证/迟到响应不能改新实例，取消/结果只接纳一次。
expected.en: Old credentials and late replies cannot affect a new instance; terminal outcomes are admitted once.

title.zh: Web、手机与远程环境回退

steps.zh: 在相应环境查看含 Showcase 工具结果的会话。
steps.en: View Showcase tool results from Web, mobile and a remote workspace.

expected.zh: 普通工具记录可读；不为这些路径创建本地 MCP App 沙箱。
expected.en: Ordinary tool records stay readable without creating local MCP App sandboxes.

title.zh: 请求接纳时固定当前模型
title.en: Freeze the task model at admission

steps.zh: 发起 sampling 后改任务模型，完成后再发一次。
steps.en: Start sampling, change the task model, then make another request after completion.

expected.zh: 在途请求仍用原模型，新请求使用新模型；显示返回 model。
expected.en: The in-flight request retains its model; the next uses the new model shown in the result.

title.zh: 来源撤销与窗口关闭取消

steps.zh: 在隔离任务发起请求，再禁用插件/关闭窗口；配合 sampling fixture。
steps.en: Start a request in an isolated task, revoke the plugin or close the window; use the sampling fixture for evidence.

expected.zh: 原请求中止，旧凭证拒绝，页面与监听器释放。
expected.en: The request is aborted, old credentials are rejected and page/listeners are released.

title.zh: 纯图片与资源链接内容扩展

steps.zh: 查看当前宿主计划，等待接口实现及验收后启用。
steps.en: Consult the current host plan; enable this only after implementation and verification.

expected.zh: 当前不提供演示按钮，不能把资源可读当作模型已收到。
expected.en: No demo action is offered; readable resources do not prove delivery to the model.

title.zh: App 工具双向进度

steps.zh: 等待 App 工具路径接通 SDK onprogress。
steps.en: Wait for SDK onprogress to be connected through the App tool path.

expected.zh: 当前不显示伪进度；模型工具行进度仍由 SC20 演示。
expected.en: No fake progress is shown; model-tool progress remains available in SC20.

title.zh: 模型调用页面工具

steps.zh: 保持实验室打开，请模型调用 page_edit；delayed=true 时在页面完成或停止主回合。
steps.en: Keep this lab open and ask the model to call page_edit; with delayed=true, complete it here or stop the main turn.

expected.zh: 遵循现有审批；工具在原页面执行，取消不改便签，关闭后撤销工具。
expected.en: Existing approval applies. The tool runs in its original page; cancellation leaves the note unchanged and teardown unregisters it.
